<b>Liquid Lacquer</b> is a [[Delivery Wishes|Delivery Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>, acquired from [[Couriers Tipp & Pill]] after completing the Delivery Wish <i>[[Queen's Egg (Wish)|Queen's Egg]]</i> or by being in {{Steel Soul Icon Mini|SS}} [[Steel Soul Mode (Silksong)|Steel Soul Mode]], and also after obtaining the [[Faydown Cloak]], completing at least one delivery and playing the [[Threefold Melody]]. 
__NOTOC__

== Delivery Item ==
[[File:Liquid_Lacquer.png|link=Liquid Lacquer|left|thumb|100x100px]]
The [[Liquid Lacquer]] has a total of 3 hit points. It takes 1 damage for every Mask of damage Hornet takes, and also when Hornet makes a heavy landing, hits a ceiling while using [[Silk Soar]], or runs into a wall while using [[Swift Step]]. Travelling with the [[Bellways]], [[Ventrica]], [[Flea Caravan]] or using the [[Beastling Call]] immediately destroys it.
{{Clear}}

== Wish ==
[[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] is given a Liquid Lacquer by Tipp & Pill to carefully deliver to [[Mask Maker (Silksong)|Mask Maker]] in [[Mount Fay]]. Once the wish is completed, it cannot be accepted again.

{{Gallery
| Image1 = Mapshot SS Tipp & Pill 01.png!Tipp & Pill's location in Bellhart
| Image2 = Mapshot SS Mask Maker 01.png!Mask Maker's location in Mount Fay
}}

== Route ==
The most optimal route goes through [[Blasted Steps]] and the [[Choral Chambers]] to reach [[the Slab]]. From there it goes through the east part of Mount Fay to end up at Mask Maker.
{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Liquid Lacquer (Wish) 01.png!Route through Blasted Steps
}}

== Reward ==
[[File:Rosaries large.png|link=Rosaries|left|thumb|100x100px]]

By turning in the Liquid Lacquer to Mask Maker, he rewards Hornet with {{R|560}} in [[Act 2]], and {{R|650}} in [[Act 3]].

{{Clear}}
